notes.title: Update: Chinese, Korean, and Japanese Subtitles Now Available!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30682079/19400d4e6e53959ecc7e1ea18cd268be00848a80.png[/img]

The latest update for Sneaky Bears adds subtitles in Simplified & Traditional Chinese, Korean, and Japanese. WarDucks is excited to provide these subtitles to allow more users to see how hilarious evil mastermind Frank is!

Subtitles can be accessed on the right side of the console in the game. The arrows change the language while the top button turns subtitles on and off. English subtitles are also available.

Don’t let ‘em catch ya!
別讓他們抓住你！
别让他们抓到你！
그들한테 잡히지 말아요!
捕まえさせるな!
